ops.text: 11.1A Termination for Convenience. Corio is the Customer under this Agreement. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Customer any prepaid fees on a pro-rata basis for the period after the effective date of termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during any committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The five (5) year term leaves us with no exit without cause, so we have added a convenience termination right for Customer on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Commerce One has no reciprocal convenience right during a committed term. This is our standard position; we have trimmed the drafting to the minimum needed.
